languageParity: HR and EN notices carry the same substance.

hr: Javni portal prikazuje samo javne informacije i operativne sažetke.
Vijesti se provjeravaju prema allowlisti izvora i objavljuju u kontroliranim dnevnim terminima, najmanje 3x dnevno i ciljano 10+ objava dnevno.
Financijske, pravne i osobne tvrdnje idu na ručni pregled prije javne objave.
Mail Studio, admin i operator funkcije nalaze se iza zaštićenog pristupa. Nema masovnog slanja i nema kampanja.
en: The public portal displays only public information and operating summaries.
News is checked against the source allowlist and published in controlled daily windows, at least 3x daily and targeting 10+ posts per day.
Financial, legal and personal-data claims go to manual review before public publication.
Mail Studio, admin and operator functions remain behind protected access. No mass sending and no campaigns.

hr: Media korisnik sam kreira korisničko ime i lozinku te nije admin korisnik.
Prijava se može spremiti kao nacrt i kasnije nastaviti.
Slanje prijave ne znači automatsko odobrenje. Status pregledava operator za medije.
Komunikacija je individualna; nema kampanja i nema masovnog slanja.
en: The media user creates their own username and password and is not an admin user.
The application can be saved as a draft and continued later.
Submitting an application does not mean automatic approval. The status is reviewed by the media operator.
Communication is individual; no campaigns and no mass sending.

hr: Financijski prikaz je javni informativni sloj, a ne privatna knjigovodstvena evidencija.
Javni KPI brojevi zahtijevaju provjeru prije objave.
Privatni dokumenti, osobni podaci i interna evidencija nisu dio javne stranice.
en: The finance view is a public information layer, not a private accounting record.
Public KPI figures require review before publication.
Private documents, personal data and internal records are not part of the public page.
